claim: Extended agent (XA) é uma workstation LÓGICA: uma definição no banco de dados do TWS, sem nenhum processo ou agente instalado nela. Serve para estender o processamento de jobs a sistemas e aplicações externas: SAP R/3, PeopleSoft, z/OS, Oracle Applications, métodos customizados, unixssh/unixrsh.
supporting_quote: An extended agent is a logical workstation related to an access method hosted by a physical HCL Workload Automation workstation
source_title: Defining access methods for agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O XA é hospedado por uma workstation FÍSICA: pode ser o master domain manager, um domain manager ou um agent (FTA). Nunca outro extended agent.
supporting_quote: hosted by a physical HCL Workload Automation workstation (not another extended agent)
source_title: Defining access methods for agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Uma workstation física pode hospedar no máximo 255 extended agents. Vários XAs podem compartilhar o mesmo access method.
supporting_quote: A physical workstation can host a maximum of 255 extended agents.
source_title: Defining access methods for agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O access method é um programa executado pela workstation HOSPEDEIRA sempre que o HCL Workload Automation submete um job ao sistema externo. Ou seja: o método roda SOB DEMANDA, por job — não existe um 'processo do XA' permanentemente no ar.
supporting_quote: The access method is a program that is run by the hosting workstation whenever HCL Workload Automation submits a job to an external system.
source_title: Defining access methods for agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Jobs num XA são definidos como em qualquer outra workstation, exceto que os atributos do job são ditados pelo sistema externo. O retorno da execução chega via stdlist do job, que fica armazenada na workstation HOSPEDEIRA (não no XA).
supporting_quote: Jobs are defined for an extended agent in the same manner as for other HCL Workload Automation workstations, except that job attributes are dictated by the external system or application.
source_title: Defining access methods for agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Extended agents são definidos na root folder do banco de dados do TWS; não podem ser definidos em outra pasta.
supporting_quote: Extended agents are defined in the root folder of the database
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Definição de XA no composer usa TYPE X-AGENT com FOR MAESTRO HOST <workstation-hospedeira> ACCESS "<nome-do-metodo>", OS OTHER e AUTOLINK OFF.
supporting_quote: CPUNAME workstation ... [for maestro [host [folder/]workstation [access method]]] ... [type fta | s-agent | x-agent | manager | broker | agent | rem-eng | pool | d-pool]
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)
syntax:
cpuname [folder/]workstation
os os-type
[for maestro [host [folder/]workstation [access method]]]
[type fta | s-agent | x-agent | manager | broker | agent | rem-eng | pool | d-pool]
[autolink on | off]

claim: No atributo NODE da definição do XA, usar NULL quando o host é $MASTER, ou para PeopleSoft, SAP e Oracle.
supporting_quote: Specify NULL when the host is $MASTER, or for PeopleSoft, SAP and Oracle
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Exemplo completo de XA para SAP via r3batch: CPUNAME SAP_XA, OS OTHER, NODE none TCPADDR 31111, FOR MAESTRO HOST FTA_SAP01 ACCESS "r3batch", TYPE X-AGENT, AUTOLINK OFF, BEHINDFIREWALL OFF, FULLSTATUS OFF.
supporting_quote: CPUNAME XA_R3 ... FOR MAESTRO HOST LONDON ACCESS "r3batch" ... TYPE X-AGENT ... AUTOLINK OFF
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)
syntax:
CPUNAME SAP_XA
   DESCRIPTION "SAP R/3 via r3batch"
   OS OTHER
   NODE none TCPADDR 31111
   FOR MAESTRO HOST FTA_SAP01 ACCESS "r3batch"
   TYPE X-AGENT
   AUTOLINK OFF
   BEHINDFIREWALL OFF
   FULLSTATUS OFF
END

claim: Se a definição do XA estiver sem host ou sem access method, o composer retorna AWSBIA140E: 'For an extended agent you must specify the host and the access method.'
supporting_quote: AWSBIA140E: For an extended agent you must specify the host and the access method.
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Se o nome do access method na definição do XA não existir no sistema, o composer avisa AWSBIA145W: 'Access method !1 does not exist on your system!'
supporting_quote: AWSBIA145W: Access method !1 does not exist on your system!
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O arquivo do access method precisa estar no diretório methods da instalação do HOST do XA, com permissão de leitura + execução para o usuário de logon dos jobs (ou o logon definido no options file do método). Fora do diretório correto ou inacessível, os jobs falham ao lançar.
supporting_quote: If the access method is not in the proper directory on the extended agent's host, on the dynamic agent, or the method cannot be accessed by HCL Workload Automation, jobs fail to launch
source_title: Failure launching jobs on extended agents and dynamic agents (HCL)

claim: O r3batch usa dois níveis de options files: o global r3batch.opts (vale para todas as instâncias) e o local <XA_Unique_ID>_r3batch.opts (só para aquela XA). Se o local existir, ele ignora o duplicado no global.
supporting_quote: The r3batch access method uses a global options file r3batch.opts and a local options file XA_Unique_ID_r3batch.opts
source_title: r3batch access method configuration (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Opções principais do r3batch: ljuser (usuário que lança/gerencia jobs), ifuser (usuário que lê informações do job), TWSXA_LANG/twsmeth_lang/twsmeth_cp/twsxa_cp (idioma e code pages — alinhar em ambientes sem Unicode), max_name_counter/name_counter_policy (variantes SAP), rcmap/enable_appl_rc (mapeamento de return codes), retrieve_joblog/retrieve_spoollist/retrieve_ipaklog/retrieve_pchainlog, pchain_recover (rerun|restart), job_interceptable.
supporting_quote: Common options for the r3batch access method: ljuser, TWSXA_LANG, rcmap, pchain_recover
source_title: r3batch access method configuration (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Se modificar os options files do r3batch, é preciso parar e reiniciar os processos de monitoramento do extended agent (r3evmon stop / r3evmon start) para a mudança valer. No UNIX, o comando deve ser executado pelo dono da instalação do HCL Workload Automation.
supporting_quote: If you modify the r3batch option files, to make the changes effective you must stop and restart the extended agent monitoring processes
source_title: Monitoring SAP events (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O XA NÃO aceita conman start: a referência oficial diz que no início de cada período de produção o start 'causes the autolinked fault-tolerant agents and standard agents to be initialized and started automatically' — FTAs e standard agents, apenas. O XA não tem processos locais para iniciar: basta dar start na FTA hospedeira, e o access method é invocado sob demanda a cada job submetido ao XA.
supporting_quote: The start command ... causes the autolinked fault-tolerant agents and standard agents to be initialized and started automatically
source_title: conman start reference (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: 'Extended agents are not linked; they communicate through a host.' O link/unlink se aplica à workstation hospedeira, não ao XA.
supporting_quote: Extended agents are not linked; they communicate through a host.
source_title: conman link reference (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O atributo autolink é 'Not applicable' para o tipo extended agent.
supporting_quote: autolink: Not applicable for extended agent
source_title: Workstation definition (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: O XA aparece no conman showcpus como tipo X-AGENT, com a coluna METHOD mostrando o nome do access method (só para XAs). Flags de estado: L (link primário aberto), H (linkada através do host), X (linkada como extended agent), I/J (jobman do HOST inicializado/rodando), M (monman rodando). As flags I/J refletem os processos do host — o XA não tem processos próprios.
supporting_quote: Extended agent workstations are displayed with workstation type X-AGENT and the METHOD column shows the access method
source_title: conman showcpus reference (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Para event rules baseadas em eventos SAP (requer XBP 3.0+), o monitoramento é feito pelos processos r3evmon do XA: 'r3evmon start' inicia o monitoramento de eventos SAP, 'r3evmon stop' para. Arquivos de controle por XA ficam em <TWA_DATA_DIR>/methods/r3evmon_cfg/ (XAname_r3evmon.cfg, XAname_r3idocmon.cfg, ...).
supporting_quote: start: Starts monitoring SAP events. stop: Stops monitoring SAP events.
source_title: Monitoring SAP events (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Como o r3batch lança um job SAP: recebe as informações SAP-específicas do job, faz uma cópia de um template job no SAP e o marca como 'scheduled', depois monitora o job até a conclusão, escrevendo progresso e status no stdlist na workstation host.
supporting_quote: The r3batch access method copies a template job in SAP, marks it as scheduled, and monitors it until completion
source_title: SAP R/3 batch access method (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Múltiplas instâncias SAP no mesmo host: várias XAs podem usar a mesma workstation hospedeira, cada uma com seu options file local (XA_Unique_ID_r3batch.opts) apontando para uma instância SAP diferente — o unique identifier da XA é a chave.
supporting_quote: Multiple extended agents can share the same host, each with its own local options file pointing to a different SAP instance
source_title: r3batch access method configuration (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: BC-XBP 2.0 no r3batch habilita: intercept jobs, track child jobs, keep all job attributes on rerun, raise events. Com parent-child ativo, o job HCL só termina quando parent E children terminarem (EXEC enquanto qualquer um roda).
supporting_quote: Use Business Component-eXternal Interface Background Processing (BC-XBP 2.0) interface support to: Intercept jobs, Track child jobs, Keep all job attributes when you rerun a job, Raise events
source_title: HCL Workload Automation for SAP

claim: BC-XBP 3.0 habilita o monitoramento de eventos SAP: eventos definidos pelo sistema SAP (ex.: novo operation mode) e eventos definidos pelo usuário (disparados por ABAP ou processos externos).
supporting_quote: HCL Workload Automation monitors two types of SAP event: Events defined by the SAP system ... Events defined by the user
source_title: Monitoring SAP events (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Para agendar InfoPackages SAP via HCL: no SAP, as scheduling options do InfoPackage devem ter Start type = 'Start later in background process' e Start time = 'Immediate'.
supporting_quote: Start type set to Start later in background process. Start time set to Immediate.
source_title: Creating an HCL Workload Automation job with InfoPackages or process chains

claim: Para controlar process chains SAP via HCL: as scheduling options da chain devem ser 'Start Using Meta Chain or API'. Se estiver em 'Direct Scheduling', a chain dispara sozinha no SAP, fora do controle do HCL.
supporting_quote: The scheduling options of the process chain must be Start Using Meta Chain or API
source_title: Creating an HCL Workload Automation job with InfoPackages or process chains

claim: Mapeamento de status HCL ↔ SAP no r3batch: INTRO = Not Available; WAIT = Ready/Release; EXEC = Active; SUCC = Finished; ABEND = Canceled.
supporting_quote: INTRO: Not Available; WAIT: Ready/Release; EXEC: Active; SUCC: Finished; ABEND: Canceled
source_title: SAP R/3 batch access method (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Causas documentadas de falha de lançamento de jobs no XA: access method fora do diretório correto no host; método inacessível ao HCL; usuário de logon sem permissão de leitura+execução no método. Checagens de dependência 'opens' rodam como root, a menos que outro login seja especificado no options file do método.
supporting_quote: For a job, the HCL Workload Automation jobs logon or the logon specified in the method options file must have read and execute permissions for the access method. When checking a file to satisfy an opens dependency, root is used as the login unless another login is specified in the method options file.
source_title: Failure launching jobs on extended agents and dynamic agents (HCL)

claim: O XA só lança jobs sob direção da workstation hospedeira: se a FTA host estiver down ou unlinkada, nada flui para o XA. Com o link down, mensagens ficam enfileiradas em <TWA_home>/TWS/pobox/<workstation>.msg até o link voltar.
supporting_quote: Extended agents launch jobs only under the direction of the hosting workstation
source_title: Managing production for extended agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Para diagnosticar problema no XA, ler o stdlist do job (conman sj ou console): o erro do método aparece lá, no host — ex.: EEWO0439E 'The required options are not specified either in the global or in the local options file'.
supporting_quote: Information about job running execution is sent to HCL Workload Automation from an extended agent using the job stdlist file
source_title: Managing production for extended agents (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: Eventos IDoc duplicados (IDOCEventGenerated repetido): resetar data/hora do próximo loop em <data_dir>/methods/r3evmon_cfg/XAname_r3idocmon.cfg — parar o r3evmon, apagar o arquivo (ou ajustar start_date=YYYYMMDD / start_time=HHMMSS) e reiniciar. Com idoc_no_history=OFF e sem o arquivo, ele recupera TODOS os IDocs coincidentes, não só os atuais; ON (default) usa a data/hora do arquivo.
supporting_quote: Stop r3evmon, delete the XAname_r3idocmon.cfg file and then start r3evmon again. If idoc_no_history is set to OFF and no XAname_r3idocmon.cfg file exists, then all matching IDocs are retrieved, not only the current ones.
source_title: Other known problems — r3batch (HCL Workload Automation)

claim: EEWO0778E (dependência internetwork em evento SAP com XBP 2.0): verificar se o report BTCTEST existe no SAP (transações sa38/se38, buscar BTC*); se não existir, apontar placeholder_abap_step no options file local para outro report dummy existente.
supporting_quote: Check whether the BTCTEST report exists in the SAP system; if it does not exist, point placeholder_abap_step to another existing dummy report
source_title: Other known problems — r3batch (HCL Workload Automation)
